name: heads-up
description: Spoken voice alerts on your Mac when your coding agent finishes a task or needs you.

interface.shortDescription: Hear when your agent needs you
interface.longDescription: Plays a short spoken line on your Mac ("Hello. I need your review.") when a task finishes or the agent needs an approval, input or a review. Stays quiet on calls, in Focus, when you're away or outside your quiet hours.
interface.defaultPrompt: Tell me out loud when you're done.
